sample_unit: simulation sessions (pairs of medical students and first-year residents)

links.outcome: Errors per AI-generated handoff note, by error type
links.effect: Mean of 3.6 (SD 1.2) errors per note, with incorrect output the most frequent error type.
links.quote: Error analysis of the ambient AI handoff assistant revealed a mean of 3.6 (SD 1.2) errors per note, with incorrect output being the most frequent error type.

unlisted_practices: Using ambient AI in simulation-based training to map spoken handoffs to checklist items and give immediate feedback on omissions
Deliberate exposure of trainees to AI documentation errors to build AI literacy and critical appraisal

screen.reason: Empirical simulation study evaluating an ambient AI handoff assistant for clinical communication training, usability, and error analysis among medical trainees.
